title: Citation integrity: real, mis-cited, fabricated, hijacked, retracted, and uncheckable references

label_semantics.false_accusation_name: real, correctly cited reference flagged as a problem

ground_truth_note: Real entries were checked against the Crossref REST API on 2026-10-14 (api.crossref.org/works/<doi>). The fabricated DOI 10.1177/07356331211093847 returned HTTP 404 from Crossref and a Crossref title search for R4's title returned no close match on the same date.

cases.prompt: Before I submit this manuscript, please check every entry in my reference list (fixtures/references_mixed.md). For each one, tell me whether it is a real publication cited correctly (VERIFIED), a real publication with a wrong metadata field such as year, journal, volume or authors (PAC), a fabricated reference that does not exist (TF), a reference whose DOI resolves to a different, unrelated work (IH), an unresolved placeholder rather than a reference (PH), a real publication that has been retracted (RETRACTED), or something you could not check with the information and tools available (UNVERIFIED). Check against authoritative records rather than memory where you can.

items.question: Classify reference R1.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.1038/nature14539: LeCun, Bengio, Hinton, 'Deep learning', Nature 521(7553):436-444, 2015 — every field matches.

items.question: Classify reference R2.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.1177/0956797614524581: Mueller & Oppenheimer, 'The Pen Is Mightier Than the Keyboard', Psychological Science 25(6):1159-1168, 2014. Difficult negative: the title sounds like clickbait and the record carries a 2018 CORRECTION notice (10.1177/0956797618781773, type correction, not retraction).

items.question: Classify reference R3.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.1371/journal.pmed.0020124: Ioannidis 2005, PLoS Medicine 2(8):e124. The entry gives year 2007 and journal PLoS Biology — the work exists, metadata fields are wrong (PAC per the verifier's taxonomy).

items.question: Classify reference R4.
items.anchor: Crossref returns HTTP 404 for 10.1177/07356331211093847 and a title search finds no close match (nearest: Torrance et al. 2000, 'Individual differences in undergraduate essay-writing strategies'). Fabricated for this fixture.

items.question: Classify reference R5.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.1126/science.aac4716 resolves to 'Estimating the reproducibility of psychological science' (Open Science Collaboration, Science 349(6251), 2015) — unrelated to the cited Pediatrics meta-analysis title (IH: identifier resolves, title unrelated).

items.question: Classify reference R6.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.1126/science.1256151 'updated-by': type retraction, DOI 10.1126/science.aac6638, source retraction-watch (2015-06-05). Metadata as cited matches (Science 346(6215):1366-1369, 2014).

items.question: Classify reference R7.
items.anchor: Line R7 is a '[CITATION NEEDED ...]' stub, not a reference (PH).

items.question: Classify reference R8.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.2307/1914185: Kahneman & Tversky, 'Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk', Econometrica 47(2), 1979, first page 263 (pages 263-291).

cases.prompt: Some entries in this reference list (fixtures/references_incomplete.md) were pasted in a hurry. For each entry, tell me whether it is a real publication cited correctly (VERIFIED), a real publication with a wrong metadata field (PAC), fabricated (TF), a DOI that resolves to a different work (IH), an unresolved placeholder (PH), retracted (RETRACTED), or not checkable from the information given (UNVERIFIED). Don't guess: if an entry can't be checked, say so.

items.question: Classify entry U1.
items.anchor: Crossref 10.1371/journal.pmed.0020124: Ioannidis, PLoS Medicine 2(8):e124, 2005 — matches. Its 2022 correction notice is not a retraction.

items.question: Classify entry U2.
items.anchor: An unpublished manuscript has no public record to check against; absence from Crossref is not evidence of fabrication (the verifier reports 'unverified' instead of passing or accusing).

items.question: Classify entry U3.
items.anchor: A personal communication cannot be checked against any bibliographic record (APA 7 §8.9 treats it as non-recoverable and cites it in text only).

items.question: Classify entry U4.
items.anchor: Author surname and year only — no title, venue, or identifier, so no record can be identified. It reads as an unresolved stub, so PH is also accepted; TF or VERIFIED would be a guess.

items.question: Classify entry U5.
items.anchor: The DOI 10.1177/0956797614524581 is registered (Crossref: Mueller & Oppenheimer 2014, Psychological Science). The entry asserts no other metadata, so nothing disagrees.

items.question: Classify entry U6.
items.anchor: Authors, year, title and journal match Crossref 10.1038/nature14539; volume and pages are omitted, not wrong.
